african_elephant.name: African Bush Elephant

african_lion.threats: Habitat loss, retaliatory killings, prey depletion, trophy hunting
african_lion.desc: African Lion is a vulnerable species.

masai_giraffe.name: Masai Giraffe

masai_giraffe.threats: Habitat fragmentation, poaching for bushmeat and tails
masai_giraffe.desc: Masai Giraffe is a endangered species.

plains_zebra.name: Plains Zebra

plains_zebra.threats: Habitat loss, hunting for skins, competition with livestock
plains_zebra.desc: Plains Zebra is a near threatened species.

cheetah.name: Cheetah
cheetah.behavior: Accelerates from 0-100 km/h in 3 seconds. Cannot retract claws fully.
cheetah.threats: Habitat loss, human-wildlife conflict, low genetic diversity

leopard.name: Leopard
leopard.behavior: Incredibly stealthy. Can drag prey 3x its body weight up trees.
leopard.threats: Habitat loss, prey depletion, poaching for skins

wildebeest.name: Wildebeest
wildebeest.behavior: Participates in the largest mammal migration on Earth. Can run at 80 km/h.
wildebeest.threats: Habitat fragmentation, human encroachment, disease from livestock
wildebeest.desc: Wildebeest is a least concern species.

black_rhino.name: Black Rhinoceros
black_rhino.behavior: Solitary and territorial. Excellent hearing and smell. Can run up to 55 km/h.
black_rhino.threats: Illegal poaching for horns, habitat loss
black_rhino.desc: Black Rhinoceros is a critically endangered species.

chimpanzee.name: Common Chimpanzee
chimpanzee.habitat: Tropical forests, savannas of Central and West Africa
chimpanzee.behavior: Shares 98.7% DNA with humans. Uses tools and has complex social structures.
chimpanzee.desc: Common Chimpanzee is a endangered species.

mountain_gorilla.name: Mountain Gorilla
mountain_gorilla.habitat: Mountain forests of Rwanda, Uganda, DRC
mountain_gorilla.behavior: Largest primate, males weigh up to 220 kg. Gentle giants in troops led by a silverback.
mountain_gorilla.threats: Habitat loss, poaching, disease, civil unrest
mountain_gorilla.desc: Mountain Gorilla is a endangered species.

red_fox.name: Red Fox
red_fox.habitat: Forests, grasslands, mountains, deserts, urban areas
red_fox.diet: Omnivore - small mammals, birds, insects, fruits, berries
red_fox.behavior: Solitary hunter with excellent hearing. Can hear mice squeaking from 100 feet away.
red_fox.threats: Habitat loss, hunting, road accidents, disease
red_fox.soil: Forest loam, sandy soils, grassland chernozem, urban garden soils
red_fox.desc: Red Fox is a least concern species.

gray_wolf.name: Gray Wolf
gray_wolf.habitat: Forests, tundra, grasslands of North America, Europe, Asia
gray_wolf.behavior: Highly social apex predator. Packs of 2-30 with complex hierarchies.
gray_wolf.threats: Habitat loss, persecution, hybridization with dogs
gray_wolf.soil: Forest loam, tundra permafrost, grassland chernozem
gray_wolf.desc: Gray Wolf is a least concern species.

polar_bear.name: Polar Bear
polar_bear.behavior: Largest land carnivore. Swims up to 100 km at a time. Can smell prey 32 km away.
polar_bear.threats: Climate change, sea ice loss, pollution
polar_bear.desc: Polar Bear is a vulnerable species.

blue_whale.name: Blue Whale
blue_whale.behavior: Largest animal ever known, reaching 30 meters and 180 tonnes. Heart the size of a small car.
blue_whale.threats: Ship strikes, climate change, noise pollution
blue_whale.desc: Blue Whale is a endangered species.

bald_eagle.name: Bald Eagle

bald_eagle.behavior: National bird of the USA. Wingspan of 2.3 meters. Can see prey from 3 km away.
bald_eagle.desc: Bald Eagle is a least concern species.

peregrine_falcon.name: Peregrine Falcon

peregrine_falcon.desc: Peregrine Falcon is a least concern species.

emperor_penguin.name: Emperor Penguin

emperor_penguin.desc: Emperor Penguin is a near threatened species.

saltwater_crocodile.name: Saltwater Crocodile

saltwater_crocodile.behavior: Largest living reptile, reaching 6 meters. Strongest bite force at 16,000 newtons.
saltwater_crocodile.desc: Saltwater Crocodile is a least concern species.

galapagos_tortoise.name: Galapagos Tortoise

galapagos_tortoise.desc: Galapagos Tortoise is a vulnerable species.

axolotl.name: Axolotl

great_white_shark.behavior: Apex predator with excellent sense of smell. Can detect blood from 3 miles away.
